purpose: Teach: プロダクション/自負/特長/館長/主語/一部分/コンセンサス/求む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、映像プロダクションへの投資を検討しろ
lines.en: I want you to look into investing in a video production company.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Authority without raised volume. Clipped consonants on the key directive. The tone of someone who expects the instruction to be understood and executed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の品質に自負を持って参ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with confidence in our company's quality.
lines.style: Respectful, professional formality. Clear enunciation on the commitment. Slight forward lean in posture. Not obsequious—competent assurance delivered to an equal's ears.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品の特長を明確に打ち出せ
lines.en: Make sure the product's distinctive features stand out clearly.
lines.style: Crisp, decisive delivery. Slight emphasis on 'clearly'—not negotiable. Sits back slightly. The rhythm of someone distilling a business problem into its core.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社史館長の取材を受けます
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up an interview with the company museum director.
lines.style: Affirming and task-focused. Moderate pace, steady. Reports back like he's already mentally moving to the next step. No flourish, just competent forward momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プレゼン資料の主語を明確にしろ
lines.en: Make the subject clear in your presentation materials.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Emphasis lands on 'subject'—this is the crux. Lean back slightly; the posture of someone who's seen presentations fail on ambiguity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案の一部分を再構成します
lines.en: Understood. I'll restructure parts of the proposal.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Deliberate pace—not rushed, but efficient. Slight nod. The tone of someone who has made note and is already working through the revision in his head.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員のコンセンサスを取れ
lines.en: Get consensus from the executive team.
lines.style: Lower register, almost conversational but still directive. Weight on 'consensus'—this is political, not just procedural. The tone of someone who knows what meetings will come next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。優秀な人材求むの広告を出します
lines.en: Understood. I'll put out a recruitment ad for talented staff.
lines.style: Confirmatory and forward-looking. Slight rise at the end—not a question, but the natural lift of someone moving to action. Clear enunciation on 'recruitment'. Professional close.
